name: Kaede
source:
Hime's attendant and maid that takes care of her in place of her busy parents. She is an expert at housework. She dotes on Hime too much and gets nosebleeds if she becomes too excited. She is willing to kill if it's for Hime's sake, and she warns the protagonist whenever possible.

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/初恋サクラメント]Wikipedia[/url]]
